description: Creates or updates a Salesforce Validation Rule on any object via the Metadata API. The errorConditionFormula returns TRUE when data is INVALID. Use for data quality enforcement.

errorConditionFormula.description: Formula returning TRUE when data is INVALID, e.g. "AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won'),ISBLANK(CloseDate))"

errorDisplayField.description: Field API name to display error next to, e.g. 'CloseDate'. Blank = top of page.

errorMessage.description: Error shown to user when validation fails (max 255 chars)

ruleName.description: API name for the rule, e.g. 'Require_Close_Date'

name: sf_create_validation_rule
title: Create Salesforce Validation Rule
